data.name: Lokesh Kumawat
data.headline: I build fast e-commerce stores and custom software that save businesses time.
data.bio:
Hi, I’m a frontend and e-commerce developer and the founder of OptimizeAI, a web development and automation agency.

I help furniture brands and manufacturers get online and run smoother. On the storefront side, I build and migrate Shopify and WordPress stores, from custom design to launch, including moving product data from platforms like PrestaShop. On the software side, I build tools that replace manual work: a full ERP for a manufacturing and export company, a B2B product management platform that generates catalogs and quotations, and a label-sorting tool for marketplace sellers.

If you’re stuck between spreadsheets, repeated manual tasks and a website that doesn’t sell, that’s the kind of problem I like solving.
data.expertise: UI/UX, Web Design, Wireframing, Branding, Design UI, Motion, illustration, Product Design, Animation, Data Scraping, Automation and Data Entery
data.skills: WordPress, Shopify, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Python, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, PrestaShop, Shopify, W3 CSS, Figma, Wix Studio, Spline
data.home_intro: As a frontend and e-commerce developer, I specialize in building minimalist, fast, and scalable websites using technologies like Shopify, WordPress, TailwindCSS, and JavaScript.
data.home_description: From furniture brands to niche product stores, I help businesses transform their digital presence — whether it’s through custom storefronts, UI/UX improvements, or seamless product data migration. Welcome to my portfolio — a curated collection of my skills, my process, and the live projects I’ve contributed to. Let’s build something exceptional together.

items.title: Nexus App
items.subtitle: ERP and Operations Platform for Manufacturing & Export Businesses
items.description: LII Nexus is a web-based ERP and business management suite built for a manufacturing and export company. Before it, teams juggled spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and email chains for production reports, task follow-ups and approvals. LII Nexus brings these into one role-based platform, so every employee sees the work assigned to them and management gets live visibility.

items.title: Label Sorter
items.subtitle: Market-palace Label Sorting
items.description: Label Sorter turns a messy multi-page shipping label PDF into a print-ready batch. It crops the blank margin off each label, detects the courier (Delhivery, Shadowfax, Valmo, FedEx, and more), groups labels by courier, and sorts them by SKU within each group. Everything runs locally in the browser, so no files are uploaded anywhere.

items.title: B2B Product Management
items.subtitle: Current focus
items.description:
Currently, I’m working on a large-scale B2B product management software designed specifically for manufacturers and suppliers.

This platform is built to simplify and streamline the entire process of handling buyers and product data. It eliminates time-consuming manual tasks like creating presentations, PDFs, and managing product details across multiple Excel sheets.

With this system, manufacturers can: Instantly generate professional PPTs, PDFs, and Excel sheets Organize and manage product catalogs efficiently Share detailed product information with buyers in minutes Receive quotation requests directly through the platform Allow buyers to explore products and place orders seamlessly

The main goal of this project is to reduce manual workload, save time, and improve communication between manufacturers and buyers — all within a single, efficient system.
